sections.title: How to level up
sections.need: You'll need: souls and the shrine bonfire lit with the Coiled Sword.

steps.t: Travel to the [[Firelink Shrine]] bonfire.
Talk to the [[Fire Keeper]] and choose Level Up.
Add points to one stat at a time. Each level costs more souls than the last one.
Stop adding to a stat when it reaches its soft cap (table on the Builds page) unless your build needs more.
If you die, go back to where you died and touch your bloodstain to get your souls back. Die again first and they are gone.

sections.check: The stat you raised shows its new value on the status screen.

sections.title: How to get more Estus
sections.need: You'll need: Estus Shards or Undead Bone Shards from the world. 11 Estus Shards and 10 Undead Bone Shards exist per playthrough.

steps.t: Pick up every [[Estus Shard]]. A full set of 11 takes your flasks to 15 charges in total.
Give each shard to [[Blacksmith Andre]] in [[Firelink Shrine]].
Ask Andre to split the charges between the [[Estus Flask]] (HP) and the [[Ashen Estus Flask]] (FP). Casters need more Ashen charges.
Burn each [[Undead Bone Shard]] in the shrine bonfire. Every shard makes each sip heal more, up to +10.
If you want even more healing per sip, wear the [[Estus Ring]]: it increases the HP recovered by each Estus sip by 20%.

sections.check: The flask icon shows the new number of charges after you rest.

sections.title: How to upgrade a weapon
sections.need: You'll need: titanite of the right kind, souls, and the weapon on you.

steps.t: Bring the weapon to [[Blacksmith Andre]] in [[Firelink Shrine]] and choose Reinforce Weapon.
Use [[Titanite Shard]] to reach +3.
Use [[Large Titanite Shard]] to reach +6.
Use [[Titanite Chunk]] to reach +9.
Use one [[Titanite Slab]] to go from +9 to +10.
If the weapon came from a boss soul, use [[Titanite Scale]] to reach +4 and a [[Titanite Slab]] for +5.
If the weapon cannot be infused (a soulbound weapon, which ordinary titanite cannot reinforce either), use [[Twinkling Titanite]] to reach +4 and a [[Titanite Slab]] for +5.

If you run out of shards, give the Handmaid more ashes: she sells unlimited [[Titanite Shard]] for 800 souls once she has the [[Dreamchaser's Ashes]], and [[Large Titanite Shard]] for 4000 souls once she has the [[Easterner's Ashes]].

sections.check: The weapon's name shows the new +level and its attack rating went up.

sections.title: How to infuse a weapon
sections.need: You'll need: a coal given to Andre, the matching gem, and a weapon that can be infused.

steps.t: Give [[Farron Coal]] to [[Blacksmith Andre]] to unlock Heavy, Sharp and Poison infusions. It is in [[Road of Sacrifices]], guarded by a Black Knight.
Give [[Sage's Coal]] to unlock Crystal, Blessed and Deep infusions. It is in [[Farron Keep]], in a small round building guarded by a Darkwraith.
Give [[Giant's Coal]] to unlock Lightning, Simple and Chaos infusions. It is in [[Anor Londo]], on the Giant Blacksmith's remains.
Give [[Profaned Coal]] to unlock Dark, Blood and Hollow infusions. It is in [[Irithyll Dungeon]], in the cell with several Wretches opposite Karla's cell.
Choose Infuse Weapon at Andre.
Pick the gem: [[Heavy Gem]] for Strength, [[Sharp Gem]] for Dexterity, [[Refined Gem]] for both, [[Crystal Gem]] for Intelligence, [[Blessed Gem]] for Faith.
For Intelligence and Faith together, a [[Dark Gem]] or [[Chaos Gem]] infusion soft-caps at 30 Intelligence and 30 Faith, so stop at 30 in each for that weapon.
Compare the attack rating before you confirm. If the number goes down, cancel: your stats do not suit that infusion yet.

sections.check: The weapon's name now starts with the infusion (for example Heavy Long Sword).

sections.title: How to prepare for a boss
sections.need: You'll need: the boss card open (weaknesses, HP and strategy are on it).

steps.t: Rest at the nearest bonfire so your flasks are full.
Open the boss card and read the Weak line. Switch to a weapon or buff that deals that damage type.
Use an [[Ember]] before the fog wall. It restores all your HP, raises your maximum HP by 30% and makes summoning signs visible.

While embered, look for white summon signs on the ground (players lay them with the [[White Sign Soapstone]]) and summon that player as a phantom (a helper in your world) for the area boss. NPC helpers for each boss are on its card under Summons.
Walk through the fog and watch the first attacks before you swing. Many bosses pause to recover after an attack (the wiki says this of Iudex Gundyr): hit once or twice in that gap, then back off.
If you die, check the strategy on the card for the attack that hit you, then try again.

sections.check: The boss drops its soul and a new bonfire lights in the arena.

sections.title: How to parry and riposte
sections.need: You'll need: a shield or weapon with the Parry skill in your left hand.

steps.t: Equip a shield whose skill is Parry. Shields that can parry have a small shield icon in the corner. The [[Buckler]] and the [[Target Shield]] have a longer parry window.
Press the left strong attack button (L2 on PlayStation, LT on Xbox) just before the enemy's attack hits you.
When the enemy staggers, walk up to it and press the right weak attack button (R1 on PlayStation, RB on Xbox) to riposte.
Some enemies cannot be parried. Break their poise (their resistance to being interrupted) with hits instead: they stagger and can be riposted.

sections.check: The riposte plays a short critical-hit animation and takes a large bite of HP.

sections.title: How to turn boss souls into weapons and spells
sections.need: You'll need: the Transposing Kiln and a boss soul.

steps.t: Beat [[Curse-rotted Greatwood]] in [[Undead Settlement]]. It drops the [[Transposing Kiln]].
Give the kiln to [[Ludleth of Courland]], who sits on the second throne in [[Firelink Shrine]].
Choose Transpose and pick a boss soul. Each soul lists the weapons, rings or spells it can become; the soul's card shows them too.
Do not use a boss soul for souls if you might want its item: once the soul is used it is gone for this playthrough.
If you kneel at the final bonfire after placing the last Cinder of a Lord, Ludleth burns away. Transpose what you want before that, or wait for the next playthrough.

sections.check: The new item is in your inventory and the soul is gone.

sections.title: How to reset your stats
sections.need: You'll need: access to Rosaria's Bed Chamber in Cathedral of the Deep and one Pale Tongue per reset.

steps.t: Reach Rosaria's Bed Chamber in [[Cathedral of the Deep]] and talk to [[Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth]].
Join [[Rosaria's Fingers]] if she asks. If you are doing [[Sirris of the Sunless Realms]]'s quest, finish it first: offering a [[Pale Tongue]] to Rosaria fails Sirris's quest.
Offer a [[Pale Tongue]] to Rosaria.
Choose rebirth. You can then reallocate your stats and change your appearance.
Rosaria allows rebirth up to five times per playthrough, so plan the new stats against the soft caps table before you reallocate.

sections.check: Your soul level is the same but the points are where you put them.

sections.title: How to start New Game Plus
sections.need: You'll need: the Soul of Cinder defeated.

steps.t: Beat [[Soul of Cinder]] and choose an ending (see Endings).
Say no when the game offers New Game Plus if you still want to explore. You go back to [[Firelink Shrine]].
Collect anything that only appears after the ending first. For example [[Yuria of Londor]] leaves her armor and weapon after the Usurpation of Fire.
Start New Game Plus from the shrine bonfire when you are ready. You keep your level, stats, gear and covenant standing; keys and story items reset.

sections.check: The game restarts at the Cemetery of Ash with your character and enemies are stronger.

sections.title: How to avoid (or cure) Hollowing
sections.need: Only matters if you leveled with Yoel of Londor.

steps.t: If you do not want the Londor ending, never choose Draw Out True Strength with [[Yoel of Londor]]. Each use gives a Dark Sigil.
If you already have Dark Sigils, expect your Hollowing to rise each time you die. At 15 your character looks Hollow; it is cosmetic.
To clear the Hollowing level for now, use a [[Purging Stone]]. The sigils stay, so it comes back.
To remove the sigils for good, give the [[Fire Keeper Soul]] to the [[Fire Keeper]] and ask her to heal them. Doing this fails the Londor quest.

sections.check: Your Hollowing is back to zero on the status screen.
